description: The daughter of immigrant parents, Democratic Senator Melissa Hurtado was born and raised in the Central Valley. She started out as an organizer, working to expand access to health care for Valley families. In the State Senate, Hurtado secured critical funding for clean and safe drinking water and strengthened public safety and fire protection. She is leading the fight to ban corrupt financial conflicts of interest for state officials, and to protect workers and consumers from corporations trying to profit illegally off Valley families. Vote Melissa Hurtado for State Senate
